rationale: Wing Chuen and Dhanush both work in robotics, but bring complementary expertise: Wing Chuen has hands-on mechatronic engineering and hardware systems integration experience from The Robot Works and MEKA Inc., while Dhanush is a full-stack roboticist focused on robot perception and software architecture at xLogic Labs. Their combination of hardware engineering depth and perception/software architecture could create interesting collaboration opportunities in robotics solutions.
intro_message: Wing Chuen Lam, meet Dhanush Baktha — both deep in robotics but from different angles (hardware systems vs. perception & software), and could explore synergies on robot design and integration challenges.
